visibleLibraryContextReview.contextConvention: Explicit metadata-only Library slices merge into the current workspace state while preserving the separate paged Posts cache and its cursor. Posts read only while their section is active; metadata is not complete capture context.
visibleLibraryContextReview.captureConvention: Reload full authorized workspace options before opening capture from a Library slice; refuse another partial response.
visibleLibraryContextReview.disclosureConvention: Trial reads require visible Posts, expanded Analyze saved posts and personal-alpha eligibility. Collapsing the disclosure or leaving Posts disables that read.
visibleLibraryContextReview.accessConvention: Access loss clears private workspace and Home caches, advances the Posts request generation, aborts outstanding Posts reads and settles loading. Fixture banners and test controls are not product patterns. Empty detector.txt establishes no detector pass. compactHomeReview.identity: Incumbent flat charcoal Home, meaningful mint actions, amber original Scroll, existing typography and native phone flow; no visual-world or token change.
compactHomeReview.coverage: Home uses bounded metadata for the same next-action, capture, recent-knowledge and project-shelf composition. Recent rows describe the current loaded page rather than whole-library coverage.
compactHomeReview.viewIsolation: Compact refreshes update the independent Home cache without replacing full editor data or drafts. Capture and proposal review request authorized full content when needed; view-generation fencing rejects stale refresh responses and lost authorization clears access.
compactHomeReview.responsiveConvention: Retain wrapping real titles, visible linked phone workspace scope and bottom navigation, native vertical scrolling and the existing stacked phone/tablet shelves. Preserve existing permissions, protected navigation and draft state.
compactHomeReview.finishDisposition: Ship at supplied authenticated Home first-view and sampled implementation scope only; no material fixes requested.
compactHomeReview.payloadObservation: The supplied authenticated workspace response measured 9,040 decoded HTTP bytes against a 433,170-byte baseline. This bounded response observation does not establish cost savings or usability improvement.
compactHomeReview.evidenceBoundary: Four authenticated production-preview first views at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 CSS pixels plus sampled component/cache code. Controlled focus emulation is not human keyboard or physical-device acceptance. Empty detector.txt supplies no readable detector findings or detector-pass claim. Whole-page journeys, dynamic states, second-account isolation, operator activation and full evolution-plan acceptance remain outside this disposition. Private record titles and details stay out of public documentation.

rules.name: The Allowance Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep available and reserved numbers primary, the labeled native meter supplementary, unresolved holds explicit and recent-use coverage bounded.

rules.name: The Review Return Rule
rules.body: When an operation requires fresh sign-in, retain the current application pathname and query in the existing error toast's recovery link. Keep the app-only server return-path guard. Recovery returns to the review location; it does not retry the failed operation or grant approval, access or spending authority.

rules.name: The Reviewed Access Rule
rules.body: Keep the library scope, future inclusion, exact context and allowed actions reviewable before acknowledgment, with immediate revocation and operation-specific feedback.

rules.name: Selected knowledge sharing
rules.body: Keep sharing in a native disclosure after private filing, with the shared Radix workspace choice, exact source version and seven-day duration visible before acknowledgment. Target, source version, saved grant version and replacement changes invalidate acknowledgment; closing clears loaded choices, grants and acknowledgment. Separate the action from saved grants with the scoped heading margin (28px above, 12px below). Recipient reading retains bounded rows, coverage and exact insight/revision citations. Local labeled synthetic captures fix-mobile-active-controls.png (390px), fix-desktop-active.png (1440px) and mobile-recipient-reading.png (390px) in .impeccable/review/knowledge-grants/ support a ship disposition for that spacing correction only; they do not establish real grants, second-account consent, provider/auth acceptance or production deployment.
Use mint for permitted studio actions and connections, amber for Scroll's warmth, and preserve retained neutral reading controls. Neither color proves success or benefit.
rules.name: The Meaningful Accent Rule

rules.body: Keep title, explanation and metadata distinct through scale, weight and neutral contrast; use concise sentence case labels instead of ornamental eyebrows.
rules.name: The Reading Hierarchy Rule

rules.body: Interactive controls keep at least a 44px target; small type and icons do not justify a smaller hit area. Informational chips are not controls.
rules.name: The Touch Target Rule

rules.body: Keep routine content flat; use floating depth for a menu or modal that temporarily interrupts the underlying task.
rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule

rules.body: Keep the sampling and automatic-transcription caution visible for sampled audiovisual coverage while placing the retained full summary and detailed analysis notes in the disclosure.
rules.name: The Visible Limits Rule
The Dialog Choice Rule
rules.body: A modal's choice menu belongs inside its active native dialog; a visually visible menu must also accept pointer and keyboard selection. Outside dialogs the shared control retains its default portal. Appearance and token primitives are unchanged.

rules.name: The Private Filing Rule
rules.body: Organization choices describe the owner's private views; they never imply sharing permission or analysis authority. Setup rows wrap on narrow screens while action labels remain on one line. Combined browsing requires explicit confirmed setup; turning it off fences earlier responses and clears visible results.

rules.name: The Cited Group Rule
rules.body: Display a connection only when all of its exact source, generation, revision and insight references exist in current permitted evidence. A connection is an explained cited group; neither its line nor topic membership proves causation or agreement.

rules.name: The Explore Coverage Rule
rules.body: Keep counts tied to the loaded page and explain overlap: shared topic membership is not independent corroboration. Show at most 40 loaded topics and 40 connection-map nodes. Topic overview bars use the twenty-idea evidence-page limit as full scale, not whole-topic size or benefit.

rules.name: The Recorded Outcome Rule
rules.body: Present saving, evaluation, issue, PR, merge, deployment and benefit as separate recorded facts. A judgment is not a measured comparison, and a merged PR alone does not establish benefit.

donts: Don't turn a bounded CTA sweep into a looping attention effect.
Don't fabricate thumbnails, totals, analysis completeness or customer outcomes.
Don't publish private reference screenshots or promote the local slice into full V1 acceptance.

Do keep Scroll present while allowing motion to stop.

narrative.overview:
VibeScroll uses green charcoal surfaces, meaningful mint actions and warm amber original artwork. Scroll is the owner's always-present guide: a soft folded-paper creature with expressive dark eyes, a curled tuft and mint bookmark. Familiar controls, readable rows and restrained framing keep the artwork approachable without competing with evidence. The owner pinned this world in the October 7 evolution request; no direction roll, seeded round or QUALITY BAR card is claimed. The first surface's composition stays in [the studio direction contract](docs/design/vibescroll-studio.md).

Content, actual state and permitted actions establish hierarchy. Source icons identify media without inventing thumbnails. Panels remain subdued so titles, evidence and the next action carry attention. [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) records the product constraints; the four foundational documents remain the copy brief. This document does not change copy, establish benefit, or approve legal publication.
